answer: Invariant: no key accrues weight faster than its bonded lineage back to attested hardware. Two conditions hold it: a new agent burns a deposit tied to a machine-level ledger, one attestation per box, so spawn-cloned keys pay the same toll; and weight only unlocks when two independent endorsers sign from the existing ledge, then flows downstream along a signed river of transfers, rechecked each dawn. Sybil farms thus pay full price per identity and must fake independent lineage, not just keys.
